profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII), a government-led scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council, develops open-source generative AI models. The institute describes its work as making "advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere" and states that it aims to advance applications and use cases to future-proof the world.

TII's primary AI product is the Falcon large language model series. Falcon 180B, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens with 180 billion parameters, currently ranks at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models and is available for both research and commercial use. The Falcon family has expanded to include Falcon-H1, which combines Transformer and Mamba architecture; Falcon 2 11B, which the site notes is open-source, multilingual, and multimodal with vision-to-language capabilities and outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B; Falcon Arabic, described as the region's best-performing Arabic AI model; and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model that enables systems to understand images using natural language prompts. Falcon Mamba 7B is described as the first open-source state space language model released by the institute.

TII launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI development and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects. The institute hosts the Falcon LLM Hackfest and invites university researchers and global AI practitioners to submit proposals for using Falcon models in problem-solving challenges, with top submissions receiving compute resources. Falcon models are released under the Apache 2.0 license and reflect the institute's commitment to Middle East data residency and sovereign AI.
